name: pubmed-mcp-server
description: PubMed / PMC / iCite search and citation tools for MCP clients (10 tools, stdio).
long_description: Local stdio MCP server exposing NCBI PubMed, PubMed Central and iCite APIs. Provides 10 tools: search (with MeSH, filters, pagination), fetch, fetch_batch, get_full_text (section-aware PMC full text), count, find_similar_articles, export_to_ris, get_citation_counts, convert_ids (PMID/PMCID/DOI), and batch_process. All tools return structured JSON. Optionally accepts an NCBI API key to raise the rate limit from 3 to 10 requests/sec.

ncbi_api_key.title: NCBI API Key
ncbi_api_key.description: Optional NCBI E-utilities API key. Raises the rate limit from 3 to 10 requests/sec. Get one free at https://account.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/settings/

tools.name: search
tools.description: PubMed search with MeSH support, filters, pagination and output modes

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a single PubMed abstract by PMID

tools.name: fetch_batch
tools.description: Fetch multiple PubMed abstracts in one call

tools.name: count
tools.description: Result count only, for fast query refinement

tools.name: find_similar_articles
tools.description: Find similar articles via NCBI elink

tools.name: export_to_ris
tools.description: Export citations as RIS for EndNote/Zotero/Mendeley

tools.name: get_citation_counts
tools.description: Citation counts via iCite or elink

tools.name: convert_ids
tools.description: Convert between PMID, PMCID and DOI

tools.name: batch_process
tools.description: Run multiple operations over a PMID list in one call
